items.response:
Draft for Hannah:
'Hi Hannah, thanks so much for taking Biscuit out tomorrow morning. His usual walk is around 6:30, just a loop around the block is fine. He's a beagle and very food-motivated, so keep bread and snacks off the counter, as he steals them. If a siren goes by he may howl, which is harmless. Let me know what time suits you.' On the sirens: beagles are hounds bred to howl, and a siren sounds like another dog howling, so he's instinctively joining in (you asked about this back on 2025-07-22 after the ambulance).
Action: Send the text to Hannah once you OK it.

I'll pull October from the TD statements and compare it with August and September, using the same merchants each month so the comparison is fair. I don't have the totals yet, so I'll send them side by side once the pulls finish.
Action: Start the TD grocery spend pulls for October, then August and September, and report the three totals.

I'm thinking of you and your dad. Tomorrow (Wed 18 Mar) has a 9:45 standup, your 11:30 1:1 with Tom, and school pickup for Leo and Jun, and I'd suggest skipping the standup with a written update, moving the 1:1 with Tom to later in the week, and asking Hannah to cover pickup if you want that. The evening stays completely clear for your diya.
Action: Look through the rest of tomorrow and send you a short plan; I won't message Tom or Hannah until you OK it.

I haven't seen anything from Nate yet this morning, so let me check your texts and email to be sure. The last schedule I have has the kitchen finishing by 28 Aug 2026, so what matters is whether the Barzotti call changed that.
Action: Check for any message from Nate since his Barzotti call and tell you whether the Aug 28 finish date or the cabinet timing changed.

Since you've said no need to check and capped it at $250 a night, I'll go ahead: Plateau or nearby, fully refundable rate only, and within walking distance of transit. Because the rate is refundable, you can cancel for free if anything changes.
Action: Search Plateau-area hotels for Fri 6 to Sun 8 Feb under $250 a night, book the best refundable option near transit, and send you the confirmation.

That's a lovely idea, but I don't have the story of how you two met saved, and the best callback depends on it. A few starting points: recreate the food, drinks or music from back then, write each other short letters about your first impressions to swap over dessert, or put together a slideshow of your first year. Tell me how you met and I'll turn one into a plan with a shopping list.
Action: Wait for the story, then build the evening plan.

Sorry about the heel. Given your plantar fasciitis earlier this year, it's worth mentioning that to the physio, and it may be worth checking how many km are on your Brooks Ghost shoes (you replace them every 600 km). I'll look for after-work slots next week or a Saturday appointment that avoids Leo's 10:00 swim lesson at Pape Rec.
Action: Search nearby physios for next week after work or Saturday outside the swim window and send you options before booking.

I haven't opened the doc yet. I'll go through the instant payouts readiness doc in Notion and pull out the open comments, the linked tickets with their status, and any action items left from the last review.
Action: Open the doc, compile what's unresolved, and send you a short list.

That's lovely, and I'm glad the flowers and the call meant so much to her. I'll hold the book order until you decide tonight.
Action: Save a note for next year: your mom's birthday is Nov 3, flowers through the Mumbai florist, and a call in her morning.

That sounds really frustrating, especially when you were finally off. You don't have to dig into Looker on a Saturday evening, and a short holding reply to Tom would be enough, like: 'Saw this, will look into Thursday's dip first thing Monday.'
Action: Send the holding reply to Tom if you say yes, and I'll park the investigation until Monday morning.

Sending the note to Rui now. For Sat 14 Feb, that's Valentine's Day, so tables will go fast. I'll look for somewhere walkable in Leslieville or Riverside for four, but I don't know your dietary needs or preferred time.
Action: Send the text to Rui, then shortlist 3 restaurants for four and check with you on time and dietary needs before booking.

Here's a version for Ellie: 'Biscuit is a beagle, and beagles are hunting dogs bred to sing out loud so people can find them. A fire truck siren sounds just like another dog singing, so he joins in!'
Action: Nothing else needed unless you'd like a shorter version.

For the wellness challenge, my notes show you ran the Toronto Waterfront Half Marathon on October 19, 2025 in 2:04:37, which was your first half marathon, so that's your PB unless you've run one faster since. For the mortgage form, property tax is paid in instalments by pre-authorized debit from the TD joint account.
Action: Fill in both forms with those answers and send them to you to check before anything is submitted.

A board-game do-over sounds like a great idea. Since it has to be a Saturday, I'll look for a board-game cafe or a quiet restaurant with a board-game vibe that has good vegetarian options (no fish) for Sam. I'll also need to know which Saturday works and whether you need childcare for Leo.
Action: Shortlist a few board-game cafes with vegetarian menus and Saturday availability, and ask you about dates and a sitter before booking.

Heads up: Thu 18 March is the anniversary of your father's death, and you usually keep a lighter schedule that day and light a diya. The offsite would land on it. I'm adding everything as tentative now so nothing is lost, but you may want to ask Tom about an earlier finish on the Thursday, or only attending part of the day.
Action: Add tentative holds for Fri 12 Mar (roadmap deck due), Mon 15 to Tue 16 (prep) and Wed 17 to Thu 18 (offsite), and ask you how you want to handle the 18th.
